newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-JAPAN REPEAT 10-0 DEMOLITION OF MACAU.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JAPAN REPEAT 10-0 DEMOLITION OF MACAU.

text.p: Striker Kazuyoshi Miura scored six goals as Japan thrashed Macau 10-0 in a World Cup Asian zone group four first-round qualifier on Sunday.
Japan had beaten Macau by the same score in their first match in the qualifying group in March.
It left Japan with a maximum 12 points from four matches in which they have scored 27 goals and conceded none.
They are now well placed to secure the sole qualifying place from the group for the 10-nation final regional round from which three teams will qualify for the World Cup finals in France.
Oman, who trounced Nepal 6-0 earlier on Sunday, are second with nine points from four games.
Miura scored three goals in each half while Hidetoshi Nakata netted twice. Their other goals came from Akinori Nishizawa and Hiroshi Nagami.
Japan play Nepal and Oman meet Macao on Wednesday with the final round of group matches on Saturday pitting Japan against Oman and Nepal against Macau.
